spots.bio: Volunteer-run 1913 railway station with a signal box, rail museum and history room.
spots.name: Tailem Bend Info Station and Rail Museum
spots.note: SATC attraction list and themurrayriver listing: 1913 railway station with signal box, rail museum and history room, volunteer run (hours vary). Small museum a guide names.

spots.bio: Free marked heritage walk through Tailem Bend with interpretive signs at railway cottages and the institute.
spots.name: Tailem Bend Historic Rail Trail
spots.note: southaustralia.com and themurrayriver.com: free marked heritage walk/drive with interpretive signs (railway cottages, institute); a guide's walking route. Short.

spots.bio: About 21 km paddling route from Tailem Bend to Wellington in four sections, with interpretive signs.
spots.name: Lower Murray Canoe Trail
spots.note: southaustralia.com free trail: about 21 km paddling route Tailem Bend to Wellington in four sections with interpretive signs; a promoted water trail. Marginal as no single point, so placement at Tailem Bend start.

spots.bio: Museum of River History at Mannum Dock where the 1897 paddle steamer PS Marion can be boarded.
spots.name: Mannum Dock Discovery Centre
spots.note: SATC attraction (museum and PS Marion, interactive centre), free; a museum visit of 30+ min.

spots.bio: Small waterfall with car park and picnic area outside Mannum, flowing seasonally.
spots.name: Mannum Waterfalls
spots.note: SATC attraction with carpark, picnic area, free; second-tier stop. Objection: small seasonal flow, short visit.

spots.bio: Mannum collection of historic motorbikes and memorabilia, about 52 bikes on display.
spots.name: River Rides Motorcycle Museum
spots.note: Tourism board's 777 Motor Museum Trail calls it an extensive collection of historic motorbikes and memorabilia; about 52 bikes on display, open most days 9am-4pm in Mannum. A small museum a guide names.

spots.bio: Mannum reserve with a replica boiler and pumping engine marking the first Murray paddle steamer, PS Mary Ann.
spots.name: Mary Ann Reserve
spots.note: SATC attraction and Traveller guide: Mannum reserve with the PS Mary Ann boiler replica and pumping engine, an Engineers Australia national heritage marker for the first Murray paddle steamer. Short stop.

spots.bio: Bird sanctuary and picnic area at Mannum on the Murray.
spots.name: Hermann Gass Bird Sanctuary
spots.note: Named on southaustralia.com attractions; bird sanctuary and picnic area at Mannum.

spots.bio: A 95 ha National Trust bird sanctuary near Mannum with 208 native plant species and a c.1900 pug-and-pine cottage.
spots.name: Lenger Reserve
spots.note: SATC and themurrayriver: 95 ha National Trust bird sanctuary near Mannum with 208 native plant species and a c.1900 pug-and-pine cottage. Case against: remote, little infrastructure.

spots.bio: Campground and dune walk to the Coorong's Ocean Beach, a distinct access point on the Younghusband Peninsula.
spots.name: 42 Mile Crossing
spots.note: Named on southaustralia.com attractions and Coorong NP page: campground and dune walk to Ocean Beach; distinct access point.

spots.bio: The 4WD-only ocean beach of the Younghusband Peninsula, a filming location for Storm Boy.
spots.name: Ninety Mile Beach (Coorong)
spots.note: Agency names Ninety Mile Beach (4WD only) as a Storm Boy filming location on the Younghusband Peninsula ocean beach; Wikivoyage's Coorong Beach is the same stretch. If a separate Coorong ocean-beach candidate exists, treat as duplicate. Needs coordinates on the SA side.

spots.bio: A 1.2 km, 20-minute walk to a viewing area over Australia's largest Australian pelican breeding colony.
spots.name: Jack Point Pelican Observatory Walk
spots.note: Agency lists Jack Point as home of the largest Australian pelican breeding colony; 20-minute 1.2 km walk to a viewing area.
